label: ComfyUI (local, e.g. under Stability Matrix) - images, sfx, music, video
description: Generates assets through a local ComfyUI. Copies the tested workflow library and the model catalog into forge/assets/ and adds the comfyui: block to forge.yaml. Models stay in the shared ComfyUI/Stability Matrix models folder; `forge assess` writes forge/assets/models.lock.json with the exact files this project uses. Nothing is downloaded at install time.
